claims.title: Conditional normal reparametrization
claims.accepted: Smooth or jointly C2,1 nondegenerate fixed-topology cylinder gives normal coordinates; integrable Lipschitz label field gives unique AC flow when the chain rule applies.
claims.limitation: These hypotheses are not proved for general optimal motions; joint C1,1 input alone does not automatically give joint C1,1 label flow.

claims.title: Weak area comparison
claims.accepted: For bounded finite-perimeter space-time Q, inward normal nu, projected effort max(|nu_x|-nu_0,0) H2 bounded by M dt, and L1 traces, DA >= (2 sqrt(pi A)-M)dt. Positive-solution scalar comparison includes nonnegative singular increments.
claims.limitation: Reduced perimeter and traces, not arbitrary topological representatives; no automatic BV-to-AC upgrade or budget saturation.

claims.title: Continuous-speed optimal critical disk
claims.accepted: At M=2 pi R, the C1 center with |t-t0|^(3/2) profile gives an area-optimal disk motion with continuous all-times speed, unique normal paths and joint C1 coordinates but no joint C1,1 normal coordinates.
claims.limitation: Does not disprove AC trajectories or existence of a regular optimal selection; stationary disk remains smooth optimal. Hard-budget nonnegative area objectives only.

claims.title: Kink optimal critical disk
claims.accepted: Lipschitz kink center gives weak a.e.-admissible area-optimal disk with no joint C1 boundary parametrization across reversal and unique AC normal paths.

claims.title: Graph nonuniqueness
claims.accepted: Exact translated C1,1/2 graph has zero and delayed positive/negative normal-label solutions, and can occur in an admissible compact boundary.
claims.limitation: Admissible only; not an optimality counterexample.

claims.title: Annulus topology
claims.accepted: Fixed outer circle and shrinking inner hole give admissible positive-budget component loss and prevent continuation of all boundary labels.

claims.title: Shrinking optimal disk
claims.accepted: Supercritical budget relative to initial perimeter gives scalar optimal shrinking disk, exact extinction time, AC radial paths with unbounded endpoint speed.
claims.limitation: No nondegenerate endpoint cylinder; empty-set boundary has no continuation. Interior pre-extinction geometry is smooth.

claims.title: General question
claims.accepted: The general optimal AC-trajectory and regular-optimal-selection questions remain unresolved in this checkpoint.
claims.limitation: No claim of full resolution or exhaustive absence of later results.
